verdict.rationale: v0's native one-click deployment is explicitly tied to Vercel infrastructure (v0-docs-8, v0-docs-32), with no evidence of direct deploy targets outside Vercel. However, GitHub integration lets developers push generated code to their own repository (v0-docs-2, v0-docs-31, v0-docs-39), which provides a path to deploy that code to any external host or self-managed infrastructure. Missing for 10: explicit support for deploying directly to non-Vercel hosts (AWS, self-hosted servers, other PaaS) and any hands-on confirmation that exported code deploys cleanly outside v0/Vercel.
